arxiv-1908-07305.title: Measurements of top-quark pair differential and double-differential cross-sections in the ℓ \ell +jets channel with p ​ p pp collisions at s = 13 \sqrt{s}=13 TeV using the ATLAS detector
arxiv-1908-07305.creator: The ATLAS Collaboration
arxiv-1908-07305.description: Abstract Single- and double-differential cross-section measurements are presented for the production of top-quark pairs, in the lepton + jets channel at particle and parton level. Two topologies, resolved and boosted, are considered and the results are presented as a function of several kinematic variables characterising the top and t ​ t ¯ t\bar{t} system and jet multiplicities.

arxiv-2109-00142.creator: Jae-Rim Koo, Young Sun Lee, Hye-Jin Park, Young Kwang Kim, and Timothy C. Beers 1 Department of Astronomy and Space Science, Chungnam National University, Daejeon 34134, Republic of Korea; youngsun@cnu.ac.kr 2 Department of Astronomy and Atmospheric Sciences, Kyungpook National University, Daegu 415
arxiv-2109-00142.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Jae-Rim Koo, Young Sun Lee, Hye-Jin Park, Young Kwang Kim, and Timothy C. Beers 1 Department of Astronomy and Space Science, Chungnam National University, Daejeon 34134, Republic of Korea; youngsun@cnu.ac.kr 2 Department of Astronomy and Atmospheric Sciences, Kyungpook National University, Daegu 415. We present a method to determine sodium-abundance ratios ([Na/Fe]) using the Na I D doublet lines in low-resolution ( R ∼ R\sim 2000) stellar spectra.

arxiv-2210-06299.title: SeKron: A Decomposition Method Supporting Many Factorization Structures
arxiv-2210-06299.creator: Marawan Gamal Abdel Hameed, Ali Mosleh, Marzieh S. Tahaei, Vahid Partovi Nia, ali.mosleh@huawei.com, vahid.partovinia@huawei.com
arxiv-2210-06299.description: Abstract While convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have become the de facto standard for most image processing and computer vision applications, their deployment on edge devices remains challenging. Tensor decomposition methods provide a means of compressing CNNs to meet the wide range of device constraints by imposing certain factorization structures on their convolution tensors.

arxiv-2306-07946.title: STUDY: Socially Aware Temporally Causal Decoder Recommender Systems
arxiv-2306-07946.creator: Eltayeb Ahmed, Diana Mincu, Lauren Harrell, Katherine Heller, Subhrajit Roy
arxiv-2306-07946.description: Abstract Recommender systems are widely used to help people find items that are tailored to their interests. These interests are often influenced by social networks, making it important to use social network information effectively in recommender systems, especially for demographic groups with interests that differ from the majority. This paper introduces STUDY, a Socially-aware Temporally caUsal Decoder recommender sYstem.

arxiv-2307-04432.creator: Shi-Yuan Ding 1,2) Wei Yang 1,2 Bao-Yuan Sun 1,2;1)
arxiv-2307-04432.description: Abstract The in-medium feature of nuclear force which includes both nucleon-nucleon ( N ​ N NN ) and hyperon-nucleon ( Λ ​ N \Lambda N ) interactions impacts the description of single- Λ \Lambda hypernuclei. With the alternated mass number or isospin of hypernuclei, such effects could be unveiled by analyzing systematical evolution of the bulk and single-particle properties.

arxiv-2402-08922.title: The Mirrored Influence Hypothesis: Efficient Data Influence Estimation by Harnessing Forward Passes
arxiv-2402-08922.creator: Myeongseob Ko Feiyang Kang Weiyan Shi Ming Jin Zhou Yu Ruoxi Jia, [1ex] Virginia Tech Columbia University {myeongseob, fyk, jinming, ruoxijia}@vt.edu, {ws2634, zy2461}@columbia.edu
arxiv-2402-08922.description: Abstract Large-scale black-box models have become ubiquitous across numerous applications. Understanding the influence of individual training data sources on predictions made by these models is crucial for improving their trustworthiness. Current influence estimation techniques involve computing gradients for every training point or repeated training on different subsets.

arxiv-2410-03319.title: Indecomposable direct summands of cohomologies of curves
arxiv-2410-03319.creator: Jędrzej Garnek
arxiv-2410-03319.description: Abstract . Groups with a non-cyclic Sylow p p -subgroup have too many representations over a field of characteristic p p to describe them fully. A natural question arises, whether the world of representations coming from algebraic varieties with a group action is as vast as the realm of all modular representations.

arxiv-2412-16412.title: InfoTech Assistant: A Multimodal Conversational Agent for InfoTechnology Web Portal Queries
arxiv-2412-16412.creator: Sai Surya Gadiraju, Duoduo Liao, Akhila Kudupudi, Santosh Kasula, Charitha Chalasani
arxiv-2412-16412.description: Abstract This pilot study presents the development of the InfoTech Assistant, a domain-specific, multimodal chatbot engineered to address queries in bridge evaluation and infrastructure technology. By integrating web data scraping, large language models (LLMs), and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), the InfoTech Assistant provides accurate and contextually relevant responses.

pmc-10547665.description: BackgroundLung cancer (LC) causes more deaths worldwide than any other cancer type. Despite advances in therapeutic strategies, the fatality rate of LC cases remains high (95%) since the majority of patients are diagnosed at late stages when patient prognosis is poor.

pmc-11461339.title: The time dependent influence of curvature and topography of biomaterials in the behavior of corneal endothelial cells
pmc-11461339.creator: Begoña M. Bosch, Luis M. Delgado, Raquel Rodríguez-González, Roman A. Perez
pmc-11461339.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Among the different layers of the cornea, the corneal endothelium, which is composed of corneal endothelial cells (CEC), plays a key role in the maintenance of cornea transparency. Based on the donor shortages and the limitations associated with transplantation, in this work we have developed collagen hydrogels with different patterned structures on the surface to provide topographies in ranges similar to the natural environment that CEC sense.

pmc-12471643.title: Amplitude of the V1-R Wave Predicts Survival After Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement
pmc-12471643.creator: Orhan Ince, Esra Donmez, Sevgi Ozcan, Kamil Gulsen, Murat Ziyrek, Emrah Ozdemir, Muhammed Furkan Deniz, Irfan Sahin, Ertugrul Okuyan
pmc-12471643.description: Background and Objectives: The function of the right heart and the pulmonary artery pressure have been linked to outcomes following transcatheter aortic valve replacement (TAVR). This study utilized the V1-R wave amplitude from pre-procedural electrocardiography as an indicator of pulmonary artery pressure, examining its connection to one-year mortality post-TAVR.

pmc-12564668.title: Optimized Alkaline Extraction and Functional Characterization of Carrageenan from Eucheuma perplexum Using Response Surface Methodology
pmc-12564668.creator: Irene P Daet, Tai-Yuan Chen, Sharon N Nuñal, Jose P Peralta, Rhoda Mae C Simora, Meng Chou Lee, Jui-Sheng Chang, Rex Ferdinand M Traifalgar, Annalisa Chiavaroli, Ramesh Kumar Saini
pmc-12564668.description: Seaweeds are increasingly valued in the food industry for their bioactive compounds, mainly hydrocolloids like carrageenan. This study investigates E. perplexum, a red seaweed, as a unique and sustainable source of carrageenan with promising functional properties. Using response surface methodology (RSM), the extraction process was optimized through alkaline extraction, identifying optimal conditions of 85 °C for 3 h with 2.

pmc-12567324.title: From Healthy Eating to Positive Mental Health in Adolescents: A Moderated Mediation Model Involving Stress Management and Peer Support
pmc-12567324.creator: Inmaculada C. Rodríguez-Rojo, Montserrat García-Sastre, Cecilia Peñacoba-Puente, Daniel Cuesta-Lozano, Leonor García-Rodríguez, Patricia Blázquez-González, Patricia González-Alegre, Juan Manuel López-Reina-Roldán, Raquel Luengo-González
pmc-12567324.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background: Adolescent mental health is a growing public health concern, with increasing prevalence of anxiety, depression, and emotional dysregulation. While nutrition is a recognized factor in physical health, its role in mental well-being, especially through holistic models, remains underexplored. Objectives: This study examines a moderated mediation model in which perceived healthy eating (self-rated diet quality) was associated with positive mental health (PMH) in adolescents, mediated by stress management and moderated by peer social support.

pmc-12854541.title: Intraoperative Detection and Management of Euglycemic Ketonemia During Emergency Surgery Using Point-of-Care Blood Beta-Hydroxybutyrate Testing in a Patient Receiving Sodium-Glucose Cotransporter 2 (SGLT2) Inhibitors: A Case Report
pmc-12854541.creator: Hiroshi Takanami, Kozue Kubo, Sachiyo Sakamoto, Munehiro Masuzawa, Takahiko Kamibayashi
pmc-12854541.description: Patients who receive sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 inhibitors (SGLT2is) are at risk of developing euglycemic ketoacidosis (EDKA), particularly during the perioperative period, if drug withdrawal is insufficient. Although current guidelines recommend withholding SGLT2is prior to surgery, adequate withdrawal periods cannot always be ensured in emergency situations.

pmc-13106070.title: Building capacity for translational team science: digital badging as a pathway to professionalization
pmc-13106070.creator: Kristine M. Glauber, Whitney Sweeney, Heather A. Billings, Mayla R. Boguslav, Andrew T. Fox, Madison Hartstein, Laura Hildreth, Diana Lee-Chavarria, Rebecca Lobb, Wayne T. McCormack, Angela Mendell, Jennifer R. Molano, Heather J. Risser, Allan R. Brasier
pmc-13106070.description: Effective translation relies on high performance teams integrating diverse disciplines to bring new drugs, medical devices, diagnostics or behavioral interventions into improved health. Despite substantial advancements informed by the Science of Team Science (SciTS), challenges remain in effective translational team (TT) operations, while limited institutional, scholarly, and practitioner legitimacy of team science expertise constrains efforts to address them.

pmc-13356631.title: An N-terminal amphipathic helix governs activity and conformational dynamics of Nramp metal transporters
pmc-13356631.creator: Majid Jafari, Hongyan Zhao, Yao Zhang, Tianqi Wang, Kenneth M Merz, Jian Hu
pmc-13356631.description: Nramps are a family of proton-coupled divalent metal ion transporters that play critical roles in maintaining homeostasis of essential metals. In humans, Nramp2 (DMT1) mediates iron uptake to support both cellular and systemic iron homeostasis, whereas Nramp1 exports metals from phagosomes, contributing to antimicrobial defense.

pmc-13495280.title: Evaluation of systemic immune-inflammatory biomarkers in eclampsia: a retrospective cohort study
pmc-13495280.creator: Aylin Yılmaz, Didar Kurt

pmc-13628606.title: Thermographic Analysis of the Cooling Dynamics of Liquid Metal Droplets
pmc-13628606.creator: Argelia Balbuena Ortega, Luckenson Augustin, Emiliano Hernández-Figueroa, Sergio Cuevas, Jesús Antonio del Río Portilla
pmc-13628606.description: This work presents an experimental study of the thermal dynamics of cooling galinstan liquid metal droplets using thermographic and optical imaging techniques. Galinstan droplets were subjected to controlled cooling on a Peltier-based system with their temperature and morphological evolution recorded simultaneously. Thermography enabled the detection of transient thermal phenomena and localized phase transitions, including supercooling and dendrite formation.

pmc-13676515.title: Nocardia antimicrobial susceptibility testing by microdilution: evaluation of ready-to-use plate including tedizolid and meropenem
pmc-13676515.creator: Mateo Dutarte, Charlotte Genestet, Gérard Lina, Oana Dumitrescu, Elisabeth Hodille
pmc-13676515.description: PurposeNocardiosis is a rare but serious infection occurring predominantly in immunocompromised patients. The CLSI microdilution antimicrobial susceptibility testing is recommended for all nocardioses. Ready-to-use plates are available (Sensititre™ RAPMYCOI), but antimicrobials of interest (e.g. tedizolid, meropenem) are lacking. At the request of the French nocardiosis reference medical biology laboratory, a plate including meropenem and tedizolid was produced (Sensititre™ FRNOCAR1).
